description: If binary sequences x and y agree at every index below k and differ at k, their prefix-code sets intersect in exactly the codes of the prefixes of x of lengths at most k, and this intersection has k+1 elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes_intersection (x y : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ) (hpre : ∀ i < k, x i = y i)
  (hne : x k ≠ y k) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes x ∩ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes y =
      (fun n => Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.binaryPrefix x n)) ''
        Set.Iic k ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes x ∩ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes y).ncard =
      k + 1
